gameDirectory.description: The game folder (the one with the executable / UnityPlayer).

dataDirectory.description: The data folder (<Game>_Data, assets/bin/Data, Contents/Resources/Data); null when absent.

company.description: Company and product from <Data>/app.info; null when absent.

platform.description: windows, linux, macos, android, ios, webgl or unknown.

architecture.description: x64, x86, arm64, arm or unknown.

version.description: The engine version as the most specific source writes it (may carry a vendor suffix, e.g. 2020.3.13f1XD1.1); null when no source has it.

normalized.description: major.minor.patch plus release (2022.3.62f1); null when unknown.

agreement.description: agree (all sources give the same major.minor.patch), disagree, single_source or unknown.

source.description: version_resource (PE FileVersion / ProductVersion), serialized_file (globalgamemanagers, mainData, level0 header) or bundle_header (data.unity3d).

metadataRange.description: Unity versions that write this Il2Cpp metadata version (e.g. 2020.2 - 2021.1); null for Mono or unreadable metadata.

metadataCheck.description: consistent (the version falls in metadataRange), inconsistent, or not_checked.

managedState.description: readable, encrypted (Assembly-CSharp.dll is not a readable .NET image), missing or not_applicable.

monoRuntime.description: Mono runtime: mono-2.0-bdwgc (MonoBleedingEdge, .NET 4.x profile) or mono (legacy Mono, .NET 3.5 profile); null for Il2Cpp.

dotnetProfile.description: API profile from mscorlib / netstandard in the Managed folder, e.g. ".NET 4.x (mscorlib 4.0.0.0), netstandard 2.1.0.0".

metadataVersion.description: The metadata header's version field as read (also when out of range).

metadataState.description: readable (built-in reader, versions 24-39), encrypted (no metadata magic), header_tampered (magic kept, header inconsistent), unsupported_version, truncated, missing or not_applicable.

scriptingAssemblies.description: Assemblies listed in <Data>/ScriptingAssemblies.json (Unity 2019.3+); what survived code stripping.

unreadableNameRatio.description: Share (0..1) of identifiers that are unreadable or one or two characters long (Assembly-CSharp type names, or the Il2Cpp metadata string heap); null when not read.

category.description: guard, transformer, packing, encryption, mod_loader, build, middleware or toolchain.

source.description: layout (file and folder names), pe_sections, assembly_markers, metadata_names or detect_it_easy.

kind.description: managed, il2cpp_data, streaming_assets, addressables, plugins, mono_runtime, mod_loader or other.

entries.description: Entries directly inside (files and folders), counted up to 10000.

nextSteps.description: Recommended tool calls, most useful first.

action.description: load_assembly, list_namespaces, apply_il2cpp_names, search_bytes, inspect_process, dump_from_memory, use_external_dumper or summarize_file.

tool.description: The tool to call; null when the step is outside this server.
